```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(leaflet)
library(jsonlite)
```

```{r}
raw <- read_json("data/wildfires.geojson")
length(raw$features)
```

```{r}
fire_1 <- raw$features[[1]]
names(fire_1)

# First ring [[1]], first coordinate pair [[1]]
fire_1$geometry$coordinates[[1]][[1]]
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
fires <- tibble(features = raw$features) |>
  unnest_wider(features) |>
  unnest_wider(properties) |>
  # Prefix with "geometry_" to avoid colliding with top-level `type`
  unnest_wider(geometry, names_sep = "_") |>
  select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, agency, state, geometry_coordinates) |>
  mutate(
    gis_acres = as.numeric(gis_acres),
    fire_year = as.integer(fire_year)
  )
```

```{r}
fires |>
  summarize(total_acres = sum(gis_acres), .by = fire_year) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = fire_year, y = total_acres)) +
  geom_line(color = "firebrick", linewidth = 0.8) +
  # Format large acre counts with commas instead of scientific notation
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title = "Total Acres Burned by Wildfires per Year (1990–2023)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Total Acres Burned",
    caption = "Source: Historical Wildfire Perimeters (wildfires.geojson)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
big_fires <- fires |>
  filter(gis_acres >= 100000) |>
  mutate(
    # Average all longitudes (element 1) and latitudes (element 2) in outer ring coords[[1]]
    lon = map_dbl(geometry_coordinates, \(coords) mean(map_dbl(coords[[1]], 1))),
    lat = map_dbl(geometry_coordinates, \(coords) mean(map_dbl(coords[[1]], 2)))
  )
```

```{r}
top_10 <- big_fires |>
  slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10)

base_map <- leaflet() |>
  # Esri WorldTopoMap works in GitHub Codespaces without an API key or Referer block
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldTopoMap) |>
  fitBounds(lng1 = -123.5, lat1 = 33.3, lng2 = -100.0, lat2 = 43.1)

# Layer each of the 10 fire boundary polygons and its popup onto base_map
reduce(
  seq_len(nrow(top_10)),
  \(map, i) {
    ring <- top_10$geometry_coordinates[[i]][[1]]
    map |>
      addPolygons(
        lng = map_dbl(ring, 1),
        lat = map_dbl(ring, 2),
        color = "firebrick",
        weight = 2,
        fillOpacity = 0.5,
        popup = paste0(
          "<b>", top_10$incident[[i]], "</b> (", top_10$fire_year[[i]], ")<br>",
          scales::comma(round(top_10$gis_acres[[i]])), " acres"
        )
      )
  },
  .init = base_map
)
```
